newsitem.title: UK: IPE oil futures drift down, NYMEX offers scant help.
newsitem.headline: IPE oil futures drift down, NYMEX offers scant help.

text.p: IPE Brent crude futures drifted downwards on Wednesday after NYMEX's opening brought little strength to a market weakened by continual falls and unimpressed by yesterday's U.S. stocks data, brokers said.

At 1415 gmt the IPE's July Brent contract stood at $17.58, eight cents above yesterday's close, but a few cents below the intra-day high. Brent failed to break resistance at $17.65 and was likely to test support at $17.50 later in the day.
Players said the front-month 999was staring at new depths, with opinion divided on how long it could hover above the new 12-month low it touched late on Tuesday.
